g.text: SD05 - Fall and Checkpoint Recovery (UC06; F01, F09, F10)
Player supplied the preceding movement through SD01 (GUI) or SD02 (CLI).
Only the selected frontend is registered; both alternatives are shown here.
Increment epoch and revision; clear accepted-command memory.
[each direction owned by the timed command]
Empty held inputs and zero velocity.
Old callbacks retain their old epoch and are ignored.
Synchronous observer delivery finishes before the tick continues.
FALL_DETECTED contains the pre-cleanup event snapshot.
This update ends with a fresh STATE_CHANGED snapshot as shown below.
Place player at latest checkpoint; velocity remains zero.
Publish fresh STATE_CHANGED for this completed tick (delivery below).
Resume listening with no held input; player must speak again.
Goal completion clears voiceSessionRequested and stops listening.
end of EVERY GameModel.update, after any synchronous cleanup
ActiveState alone allows movement. FallingState, RespawningState,
and FinishedState reject it. FinishedState.update has no movement effect.
No decision service participates in fall detection or recovery.
